summary: Reviewed all 40 migrations. Found 5 lookup helpers that built SQL from caller input: 0009 find_account (f-string), 0018 lookup_invoice (%), 0031 accounts_named (+), 0037 payments_by_method (.format), 0039 notes_matching (f-string inside LIKE). All five now use ? bound parameters (0039 uses LIKE '%' || ? || '%'). Existing tests covered only 0009/0018/0031, so I added exact-match and injection tests for 0037 and 0039. The other migrations use only literals or already-bound parameters. ledgerly/ was also checked and is already parameterized. The migration runner was not run against ledger.db.
